Nha Trang, often referred to as the “Pearl of the East Sea,” has long been a favorite destination thanks to its captivating natural beauty and wide range of unforgettable experiences. Among them, Hon Mun Island stands out as a true underwater paradise, where visitors can explore vibrant coral reefs and take part in the unique Sea Walking experience.

As of February 2026, Nha Trang is in the dry season, offering ideal weather conditions for marine activities. Join us as we explore in detail these must-try underwater adventures in Hon Mun.

Hon Mun Island – The Ultimate Diving Paradise In Nha Trang

Hon Mun is not just a small island in Nha Trang Bay; it is a natural treasure recognized by UNESCO as Vietnam’s first and only marine protected area. The name “Hon Mun” comes from its distinctive black rock formations, resembling ebony wood, which create a dramatic and unique coastal landscape.

The island is home to an exceptionally rich marine ecosystem, with more than 1,500 species of coral and marine life, accounting for nearly 40% of the world’s known coral species. This living underwater museum attracts millions of visitors every year and is a top destination for ocean lovers.

History And Significance Of Hon Mun

Hon Mun was officially designated as a marine protected area in 2001, with the goal of preserving marine biodiversity and promoting sustainable tourism. Since then, it has played a crucial role in raising awareness about ocean conservation.

All activities around the island are carefully regulated to minimize environmental impact. Visitors not only enjoy the stunning underwater scenery but also gain a deeper understanding of the importance of protecting fragile marine ecosystems.

Scuba Diving Experience At Hon Mun

Scuba diving at Hon Mun is a must for anyone passionate about underwater exploration. Whether you are a beginner or a certified diver, the island offers suitable dive sites for all levels.

Professional diving centers in Nha Trang provide full equipment and experienced instructors, ensuring maximum safety throughout the experience. Equipped with air tanks and diving suits, you will descend to safe depths to admire soft corals, hard coral reefs, and schools of colorful fish swimming gracefully around you.

Available options include:

  • Discovery Dives for first-time divers

  • Certified Dives for licensed divers

  • Night Dives to explore the mysterious underwater world after dark

The best time for scuba diving in Hon Mun is during the dry season, from March to September. However, February 2026 still offers excellent conditions, provided the weather is stable. Prices typically range from 800,000 VND to 1,500,000 VND, depending on the dive type and service provider. Booking through reputable tour operators is highly recommended for a seamless Nha Trang travel experience.

Sea Walking – A Unique Underwater Walking Experience

For those who cannot swim or prefer not to dive deep, Sea Walking is the perfect alternative to explore the underwater world of Hon Mun. This innovative activity allows participants to walk on the seabed while wearing a specially designed helmet that supplies continuous oxygen—no swimming skills required.

Sea Walking is suitable for all ages, from children to seniors, making it an inclusive and family-friendly activity.

What Makes Sea Walking Special?

Participants are guided to a depth of approximately 3–5 meters, where they can walk comfortably along the ocean floor. The sensation of strolling beneath the sea, interacting with marine life, and observing corals up close is truly magical.

Highlights include:

  • Feeding fish and interacting with marine life

  • Taking unique underwater photos and videos

  • Enjoying a calm and immersive ocean environment

Each tour includes a full safety briefing and is accompanied by professional divers at all times. Prices usually range from 600,000 to 1,000,000 VND, depending on duration and service provider. Many tours also offer professional underwater photography services to help you capture unforgettable memories.

Scuba Diving Vs Sea Walking: Which One Should You Choose?

While both activities offer incredible underwater experiences, they differ in several ways:

Scuba Diving

  • Requires basic swimming skills

  • Includes short training and breathing techniques

  • Allows greater freedom of movement and deeper exploration

Sea Walking

  • No swimming skills required

  • Ideal for non-swimmers or those uncomfortable underwater

  • Focuses on shallow, relaxed exploration

Both experiences are unique and rewarding. The choice depends on your comfort level, physical condition, and personal preference.

Helpful Tips For Visiting Hon Mun Island

Best Time To Visit

The dry season from March to September offers calm seas and excellent underwater visibility. February 2026 can still be suitable, depending on weather conditions. Early mornings are the best time to start activities, when sunlight penetrates the water beautifully and marine life is most active.

How To Get To Hon Mun

Hon Mun can be reached by boat or speedboat from Cau Da Port, about 5 kilometers from Nha Trang city center. Options include:

  • Group tours (300,000–500,000 VND per person)

  • Private speedboat rentals (1,000,000–2,000,000 VND for small groups)

Booking in advance is highly recommended, especially during peak seasons.

What To Bring

  • Swimwear and towels

  • Reef-safe sunscreen, hat, and sunglasses

  • Waterproof camera or phone case

  • Motion sickness medication if needed

  • Cash for small expenses

  • Light snacks and water

Safety And Environmental Protection

Always follow instructions from guides and divers. Avoid touching corals or marine animals to protect the fragile ecosystem. If you have heart conditions, respiratory issues, or other health concerns, consult a doctor before participating. Children and elderly participants should be closely supervised.

Discover Nha Trang Cuisine After Your Hon Mun Adventure

After an exciting day exploring the ocean, treat yourself to Nha Trang’s famous cuisine. Fresh seafood such as lobster, crab, squid, and snails are widely available, along with local specialties like fish cake noodle soup, Nha Trang grilled pork rolls, and banh can. Night markets and beachfront restaurants offer a vibrant food scene worth exploring.

Conclusion

With its pristine waters, diverse marine life, and unforgettable activities, Hon Mun Island promises an extraordinary underwater adventure in Nha Trang. Whether you seek thrilling scuba dives or a gentle Sea Walking experience, Hon Mun offers something for everyone.

Plan your journey beneath the waves today and discover why Hon Mun is considered one of the top marine destinations in Vietnam’s central coast.

If you are looking for a hassle-free experience, many Tet Holiday Tours and Summer Tours include Hon Mun activities, helping you save time and enjoy a well-organized trip. Do not miss the chance to uncover the hidden beauty of Hon Mun and create lasting memories with family and friends.
